title: Power Automate process mining: import star schema (normalised) event data
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, maker route, OneLake control and Fabric update API are supported. One descriptive statement should be narrowed because the documentation does not define storage access as what the environment can reach.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Process Mining can ingest event data without flattening it into a single wide table.
claims.quote: Power Automate Process Mining can ingest event data that isn't stored as a single wide table.

claims.claim: The star schema consists of a thin event table plus optional case and lookup tables.

claims.claim: The normalized tables are linked by foreign keys.
claims.quote: a thin event table plus optional case and lookup tables, linked by foreign keys.

claims.claim: OneLake/Fabric and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 are supported sources.
claims.quote:
OneLake / Microsoft Fabric: A lakehouse with managed Delta tables, or loose Parquet or CSV files under the Files/ area.
Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2: A container with CSV, Parquet, or Delta-Parquet folders.

claims.quote: It declares the storage backend (ADLS Gen2 or OneLake), the file format (CSV, Parquet, or Delta-Parquet), and a list of datasets.

claims.claim: The JSON maps columns to Process Mining attributes.
claims.quote: It maps physical columns (or joined columns from lookup tables) to logical roles: case ID, activity, start timestamp, end timestamp, resource, finance metric, custom dimension, and more.
